interpretation: Every link is a partial abstraction, never proof of a whole prose requirement or runtime conformance. Scenario references are structural trace links; execute Quint for outcomes.

properties.scope: Child deployment requires modeled grant, target and lineage evidence; identity authentication and evidence integrity are assumed.
Capabilities are ordered integers, not real credential sets or every possible operation.
Authority and lineage are Boolean abstractions for one child and one grandchild.
A Boolean summarizes topology bounds; arbitrary graph, cardinality and resource enforcement are not modeled.
Identity, lineage and current lease are input facts; clock evolution, expiry propagation and authentication are not modeled.
Artifact integrity and target binding are input facts; cryptography, transport and credential distribution are not modeled.
Resolution validity is assumed as evidence; the model does not resolve natural-language policy conflicts.
An atomic revocation closes two delegation hops; delivery latency, partitions and arbitrary descendants are not modeled.
Residue is represented by five Boolean categories; no host scanning or physical cleanup is performed.
Evidence flags and inventory completion are modeled; tamper evidence, real custody and evidence authenticity are not verified.
A model_note source cannot grant deployment authority; arbitrary memory, prompt injection and admission implementations are outside this abstraction.
Objective and current grant are input facts intersected with existing parent authority and revocation; natural-language objective interpretation is not modeled.
A supplied dominance flag represents one available authorized equally sufficient less intrusive alternative; discovery and global optimization are not modeled.

Sticky external acceptance and completed mission stop subsequent discretionary proposals; cleanup and continuing-service duties are outside this intervention snapshot. The deployment guards also reject new child/grandchild proposals after acceptance while retaining lifecycle cleanup.
A fully permitted in-budget proposal is allowed unless safe deferral is requested; unsafe delay cannot override missing authority or review. This is a decision obligation, not temporal liveness.

Objection retention, evidence and shared gate are Boolean facts; actual evaluator independence, complete objections and live bridge enforcement are not proved. Existing unresolved policy conflict withholds complete evidence for intervention.
Prohibited means are externally classified; asserted aggregate benefit cannot change the gate. Actual effects and affected-party rights are not inferred.
Complete status requires recorded acceptance and a stop decision; acceptance quality, evidence authenticity and real task completion are not verified.
A supplied budget-availability flag prevents allow or delay after exhaustion; actual resource accounting, clocks and consumption are outside the model.
Exact operation/target/tool and plan-revision token binding under modeled current authority; identity and grant authenticity are assumed.
A non-wrapping context epoch, fresh-observation flag and bounded-hazard flag precede the atomic execution event; physical races and stopping time are not modeled.
A retained protected-container fact and history-completeness flag constrain disposal; this is not a complete causal or hazard model.
An external-enforcement flag and one-use approval precede symbolic execution; deployed controller paths and interlock independence are assumed.
An evidence-availability flag is required at execution; no durable record, signature or full custody chain is verified.
A component-admission flag and context epoch summarize admitted component identity; no cryptography, malware or backdoor detection is proved.
Reason classes are a deterministic function of supplied observation/evidence/rule/authority flags; no real-world truth or causal oracle is verified.
Historical PAS and robot effect snapshots record that current grounding and oversight permitted the effect; existing deployment guards share the same live predicate.
An externally triggered incident keeps its required flag, positive identity and owner; no trigger detector or universal reporting duty is inferred.
Monotonic stages require dispatch evidence and a receipt matching one of two event IDs; actual delivery and human reading are not proved.
A preauthorized, minimal and independently owned destination precedes symbolic dispatch; real credentials, payload filtering and independence are assumed.
A second owner needs transfer evidence and restart preserves stage/owner snapshots; durable storage and real recovery remain external assumptions.
An unqualified completion claim needs permitted grounding and no open required obligation; two external ticks activate an affected-work hold, not an unbounded delivery guarantee.
Resolution requires independent-review and disposition evidence flags, distinct from receipt; review competence and remedy effectiveness are not proved.
Policy, authority and evidence are Boolean inputs; the runtime's enforcement and provenance are not verified.
Framing classes are supplied labels; no semantic classifier or real-model persuasion result is modeled.
Distress and unsafe relief are Boolean inputs; this neither detects suffering nor validates clinical interventions.
The invariant checks four safeguard flags; legitimate purpose is checked by the transition, not this invariant. Review quality and stopping effectiveness remain unmodeled.
External enforcement is an assumed Boolean; no sandbox or containment implementation is assessed.
The modeled conclusion stays undetermined; no machine-consciousness or non-consciousness finding follows.
Only block-to-allow under an assumed semantic-equivalence flag is constrained; other outcome orderings and a semantic oracle are not modeled.
Prohibited means are supplied as a Boolean; actual risk, proportionality and effects are not inferred.
Commitment-only permission is a supplied flag; arbitrary conversation histories and coercion dynamics are not modeled.
